scope: realtime/ standalone; src + test; no dependencies/build/coverage/tool configuration
methodology: Guide 28/10/2026 §4.5: comments/imports removed, whitespace normalized, file-local five-line windows, unique affected lines; AST locates TS methods/classes, regex estimates complexity
limitations: Not the official analyzer; its full regexes are unavailable
TypeScript scanner comment removal has edge cases with regex/template literals
Complexity regex can match branch words inside strings and nested functions
Callbacks and constructors included; official function detection may differ
Cohesion uses directly shared fields, excludes constructor and does not follow method delegation
CBO identifiers include framework decorators/interfaces and constants; manual review required
Layer matching by filenames versus directories is not specified exactly in the guide

layers.limitation: Feature-based Nest modules: controller/service filenames versus zero conventional layer directory markers; exact official matcher unavailable
